name: Google AI Ultra 5x

reset.rule: Refreshes 5 hours after the window starts, until the weekly limit is reached.
stipulations: Quota is spent in proportion to token cost, so cheaper models and shorter tasks last longer.
The 5-hour limit spreads global demand; it is not tied to your tier.

reset.rule: Refreshes fully 7 days after the window starts. The Antigravity CLI shows the exact time.
stipulations: Your weekly limit is tied to your tier.

reset.rule: Monthly with your Google One billing date.
stipulations: On a family plan, the monthly credits are one pool shared by the family group.

overage: Set "AI Credit Overages" to Always to keep going on paid AI credits (Gemini Enterprise pricing), or Never to stop at the limit. With Always, Antigravity switches back to your plan quota once it refreshes. AI credits also buy extra use in the Gemini app and Flow. On a family plan, only the manager can buy credits.

how: 5x the AI Pro usage in the Gemini app and in Antigravity. Google publishes no absolute numbers.
Antigravity models are split into two groups (Gemini; Claude and GPT). Each group has its own 5-hour and weekly limit.
The Gemini app limit refreshes every 5 hours until you reach the weekly limit. Deep Research and video use it up fastest.
Monthly: 10,000 Flow credits, 30,000 Flow Music credits, $40 Google Cloud credit, 1,000 Colab compute units, 20 TB storage.
ext: Antigravity includes Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 (thinking), with their own quota group. GPT-OSS-120b is in the same group until 30 Nov 2026.
Antigravity on Ultra gets prioritized traffic and first access to new models.
quirks: Gemini CLI and the Gemini Code Assist IDE extensions stopped serving AI Pro and Ultra on 18 Jun 2026. Use Antigravity CLI (agy); `agy plugin import gemini` brings over Gemini CLI setup.
Run `/usage` in the Antigravity CLI for exact remaining quota and reset times.
Project Genie: the Ultra FAQ says all Ultra plans include it, but the comparison table says 20x only.

Family sharing: up to 5 other people get the AI features at no extra cost. Flow credits are one shared pool. Colab units and the Google Cloud credit (Developer Program premium) are for the plan manager only. The manager must buy Ultra for YouTube Premium Family to be shared. Google doesn't say whether Gemini and Antigravity limits are per person.
Antigravity, Flow and Deep Research need you to be 18 or older.
Workspace accounts can't use Google AI plans. Antigravity gives them only a small starter quota. You need a personal Google account.

events.what: Black Friday: up to 50% off select Google AI plans. Check the Google One page before you upgrade.
Antigravity removes GPT-OSS-120b, Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 4 Argon.
Jules shuts down. It has been read-only since 11 Nov. Export your sessions with Jules Tools before then.
